# Tokenmaxxing

> Tokenmaxxing: Is AI a bubble? An essay by Jason Colapietro, Founder and CEO of Suede AI, arguing that AI is both the most transformative technology of our lifetime and a historic bubble, plus follow-up notes from Suede AI in West Palm Beach, Florida.

Author: Jason Colapietro (https://suedeai.ai/founder#person). Publisher: Suede AI (https://suedeai.ai/#organization). Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 in West Palm Beach, Florida, serving Palm Beach County from Jupiter to Boca Raton.

## Essay

- [Tokenmaxxing: A company spent $500,000,000 on AI in one month, by accident](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/tokenmaxxing/): the receipts, the case for the revolution, the case for the bubble, and the circular money. Originally on Substack: https://jasoncolapietro.substack.com/p/a-company-spent-500000000-on-ai-in

## Notes

- [Tokenmaxxing Notes index](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/tokenmaxxing/notes/)
- [What an AI Bubble Means for Palm Beach County Small Businesses Buying AI Services](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/tokenmaxxing/notes/ai-bubble-palm-beach-county-small-business/): Jason Colapietro and Suede AI on buying AI services in Palm Beach County during a bubble: four vendor questions, spending caps, and where AI pays off.
- [Token Costs, Real Value: How Suede AI Prices Agent Work for Clients](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/tokenmaxxing/notes/token-costs-real-value-agent-pricing/): Why Suede AI prices agent work by deliverable instead of reselling tokens: build, run and improve, hard spending caps, model routing and cost per task.
- [Jason Colapietro on Revolution vs Bubble: A Reading Guide to His Books](https://jasoncolapietro.github.io/tokenmaxxing/notes/revolution-vs-bubble-reading-guide/): A reading guide to Jason Colapietro's books on AI as revolution and bubble: Stake Your Claim, The Claude Code Bible and Codex in Production, with three paths.
